div.l: At acres had she been and at Iherusaleme
She had passyd thourgh many a strange reme
At Rome she had be and at boloyne
At saynt Iames in Galis and at Coloyne
She coude moche of wandryng in the weye
Gap tothyd was she sothly to seye
Vp on an ambuler ful esely she sat
I wymplyd wel ⁊and on hyr hed an hat
As brood at it were a bokeler or a targe
A foot mantyl aboute her hyppis large
And on hyr helys a peyre of sporis sharpe
In felesshyp coude she lawhe and carpe
Of remedyes of loue she coude per chaunce
For of that arte she coude the olde daunce
A Good man ther was of religyon
And was a poure parson of a toun
But riche he was of holy thought ⁊and werk
He was also a lerned man and a clerk
